interpretation: Both Materiality read callbacks settled with activeAsync zero; this is not proof of an HTTP response or successful product result.
The original materiality request has no observed headers/body and reached its original 40-second fetch guard.

cloneSnapshot, its clone-tree call, payload fingerprint and new-plan construction were never invoked in either Materiality subtree. This excludes the cloneSnapshot manual copier from the measured path; direct ACL copyValue calls were outside the clone-tree span.
All current-copy branches used a materializer. Nested snapshot branches used only ACL placeholders or materializers; no staged clone, load fallback or Dashboard source copy occurred.
materializeSnapshot is inclusive and overlaps currentSnapshots/nested snapshot costs; these spans must not be added.
The five synchronous leaf spans are disjoint in the native normal call graph. Their sum is measured elapsed time, not an exclusive CPU profiler result.
Global validation time cannot be subtracted from cloneSnapshot, and global file checks cannot be subtracted from scope guards, because each has other call sites.
The Finance snapshot-digest span includes the fresh-tuple helper and its original argument acquisition. Its elapsed time alone does not identify hits or skipped hashes.
The 184/47 numeric sequences in the completed job log and artifact stdout are identical. No numeric records are missing or duplicated.
The original fail and console ERR_FAILED are preserved. This diagnostic does not replace the full original Memory suite or add visual qualifications.
